components.name: Accordion
components.description:
Grouped set of collapsible panels where one or many can be expanded at a time.

By default only a single panel is open; set `multiple` to allow several.
Each panel delegates to 
{@link 
Collapsible 
}
 for animation and accessibility.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow multiple items open at once

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for triggers — provides document structure for screen readers (default h3)

components.name: AccordionItem
components.description:
Descriptor for a single panel within an 
{@link 
Accordion 
}
.

components.name: Alert
components.description:
Props for the Alert component, an inline feedback message used to communicate
contextual information, success confirmations, warnings, or errors within a page flow.

Dismissible alerts animate out and call `onDismiss` after the exit transition completes.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Show dismiss button

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when dismissed

props.name: actions
props.description: Action slot rendered below the description

components.name: AnimatedTag
components.description:
A Tag wrapped in a Framer Motion layout animation for smooth enter/exit transitions.
Use inside a `TagGroup` so that `AnimatePresence` can track additions and removals.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique key for AnimatePresence

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Show dismiss button

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when dismiss is clicked

props.name: onClick
props.description: Clickable tag (for filters)

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state (gold fill)

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon rendered before label

components.name: AppBar
components.description:
Horizontal sticky top bar with optional glass surface.
Replaces per-app custom navbar implementations with a
consistent, animated header.

props.name: logo
props.description: Left-aligned brand element.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned action slot (theme toggle, links, etc.).

props.name: glass
props.description: Apply glass surface with backdrop blur. Default true.

props.name: height
props.description: Bar height. Default "56px".

components.name: AspectRatio
components.description:
Constrains its children to a fixed width-to-height aspect ratio using a
CSS custom property (`--ratio`), keeping content responsive without CLS.

The child element is stretched to fill the container; use `object-fit` on
images or videos inside for cropping behavior.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width-to-height ratio (e.g. 16/9, 4/3, 1). Default 16/9

props.name: state
props.description: Current mascot state

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress for eye tracking (0-1)

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Text shown when no options match

components.name: Avatar
components.description:
A circular user avatar that displays an image, falls back to engraved initials
derived from `name`, or shows a generic person icon. If the image fails to
load, the component automatically falls back to initials or icon.

The avatar reads as a machined metal disc: warm aluminum-gradient face with a
hairline bezel, debossed initials, and a recessed LED status indicator that
breathes gently on "live" states (online / busy / away).

props.name: transition
props.description:
How the avatar reacts when `src` changes.
- `"fade"` (default) — swap instantly, matching the legacy behavior.
- `"splitflap"` — run the new image through a two-flap horizontal reveal
  that mirrors the library's SplitFlap aesthetic. Honors
  `prefers-reduced-motion` by snapping directly.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description:
Displays a row of overlapping avatars with an overflow counter when the list exceeds `max`.
Avatars are rendered in reverse DOM order so the first avatar visually overlaps the rest.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum visible avatars before showing a "+N" overflow counter

components.name: Badge
components.description:
A small status indicator label for counts, states, or categories.
Use the `dot` prop to prepend a colored status circle before the text.

props.name: size
props.description: Compact or default size

props.name: dot
props.description: Show a status dot before the label

characterLimits.reason: Inline status label; wrapping breaks layout

components.name: Banner
components.description:
Props for the Banner component, a full-width page-level message displayed at the top
of a view to communicate system status, feature announcements, or critical warnings.

Unlike Alert (inline), Banner spans the full content width and is intended for one-per-page messaging.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual and semantic variant

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Allow the user to dismiss

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Callback when dismissed

props.name: action
props.description: Optional action slot (e.g. a Button)

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description:
Navigation trail showing the user's location within a hierarchy.
Automatically collapses middle items into an ellipsis when `maxItems` is set.

props.name: maxItems
props.description:
Max visible items before collapsing middle items with ellipsis.
First and last N items remain visible. 0 = no collapsing.

props.name: separator
props.description: Custom separator — defaults to chevron

components.name: BreadcrumbItem
components.description:
A single entry in the breadcrumb trail.
Omit `href` on the last item to mark it as the current page.

components.name: Button
components.description:
Primary action trigger with tactile press feedback.
Use for any clickable action -- forms, dialogs, toolbar controls, etc.
The button scales down slightly on press to simulate physical depth change.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `"primary"` (gold fill), `"secondary"` (aluminum outline), `"ghost"` (no border).

props.name: isLoading
props.description: When true, shows a spinner and disables the button

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Optional text to show while loading. If omitted, original children are shown.

characterLimits.reason: Button label; should be concise action verb

components.name: Calendar
components.description:
Inline, locale-aware month grid for single-date selection. Controlled via
an ISO `yyyy-mm-dd` string — no `Date` objects cross the public boundary.
`DatePicker` and `DateRange` share this same ISO-string vocabulary, per
ADR-024 (`docs/adr/ADR-024-date-value-vocabulary.md`), which unifies the
value contract across all three date components.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected date as a `yyyy-mm-dd` ISO string, or `null` when empty.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected date (`yyyy-mm-dd`).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date (`yyyy-mm-dd`, inclusive).

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date (`yyyy-mm-dd`, inclusive).

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description:
Predicate deciding whether a date is disabled. When supplied it is
authoritative and wins over `min`/`max`; range bounds apply only when no
predicate is given.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for month/weekday labels.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week, 0 (Sunday) … 6. Defaults to the locale, then Monday.

components.name: Card
components.description:
A content container with elevated, glass, or flat surface treatments.
Use Card to group related content into a visually distinct panel.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface treatment: `"elevated"` (shadow), `"glass"` (translucent blur), or `"flat"` (no shadow)

props.name: tilt
props.description: Enable subtle cursor-tracking 3D tilt on hover. Disabled for `glass` variant.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Semantic heading level for the title, routed through the Heading primitive.

components.name: Chalkboard
components.description:
A stylized menu board rendered like a restaurant chalkboard. Composes with
`ChalkboardSection` and `ChalkboardItem` subcomponents. Purely presentational
— no interactivity, semantic HTML underneath the handwriting styling.

props.name: title
props.description: Top-level header (rendered as <h2>)

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Secondary context beneath the title — often a date

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual palette.

props.name: framed
props.description: Wrap with a wooden frame border.

props.name: name
props.description: Item name (e.g., "Crab Cakes")

props.name: price
props.description: Price shown on the right (e.g., "$14")

props.name: description
props.description: Optional secondary description shown beneath the name

props.name: soldOut
props.description: Marks the item as sold out — struck through visually

props.name: heading
props.description: Section heading (rendered as <h3>)

components.name: Checkbox
components.description:
Checkbox with animated check/indeterminate mark, label, and optional description.
Supports a three-state visual (unchecked, checked, indeterminate) with spring animation.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Displays a dash instead of a checkmark — useful for "select all" with partial selection

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Explains why the checkbox is disabled. Shown in a tooltip; requires `disabled` to be true.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text rendered below the label

components.name: Collapsible
components.description:
Single expand/collapse section with an animated content region.

Works in both controlled (`open` + `onOpenChange`) and uncontrolled
(`defaultOpen`) modes. The expand/collapse transition uses spring physics
and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Default open state (uncontrolled)

props.name: trigger
props.description: Trigger element

props.name: headingTag
props.description: Wrap the trigger button in a heading element for document structure (a11y)

components.name: Combobox
components.description:
Combobox — an editable, filterable listbox built on the shared `useCombobox`
state machine. Supports single selection (Autocomplete-style) and multiple
selection with removable chips, plus async loading and empty states that are
announced through a polite live region.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the field invalid (aria-invalid) and wires the error into the field chrome.

props.name: showOptional
props.description: When true and not required, shows "(optional)" after the label.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Enables multiple selection with removable chips.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (single mode, controlled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the chosen value (single mode).

props.name: values
props.description: Selected values (multi mode, controlled).

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Fires with the next selection array (multi mode).

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Search text (controlled). Provide with `onInputChange` for async filtering.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Fires whenever the search text changes.

props.name: filter
props.description:
When true, options are filtered internally by a case-insensitive label
substring match. Set to false for async/server-side filtering where the
consumer supplies already-filtered `options`. Defaults to true.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading row in the listbox and announces it.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Text shown (and announced) while `loading`.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Text shown when no options match.

components.name: ComboboxOption
components.description:
A single selectable option. `value` is the stable identity, `label` is the
display text and type-ahead target, and `disabled` options are skipped.

components.name: CommandItem
components.description:
A single entry in the command palette's item list.
Items with the same `group` value are visually grouped under a shared header.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description:
An uncontrolled, searchable command palette driven by a declarative `CommandItem[]` array.
The component owns its own search state, filtering, keyboard navigation, and grouping --
the consumer only provides the data and responds to selection via each item's `onSelect`.
Globally toggleable with Cmd+K / Ctrl+K.

props.name: groups
props.description: Ordered list of group names — ungrouped items appear first

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description:
A purpose-built confirmation dialog with confirm/cancel actions and an icon.
When `variant` is `"destructive"`, the cancel button receives initial focus
to prevent accidental confirmations.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Label for the confirm button

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label for the cancel button

props.name: variant
props.description: "destructive" renders a red confirm button and focuses cancel by default

components.name: ContextMenu
components.description:
A right-click context menu that appears at the pointer position.
Wrap any element with ContextMenu to intercept its `contextmenu` event.
Automatically adjusts position to stay within viewport boundaries.

props.name: children
props.description: The element whose right-click event triggers the menu

components.name: ContextMenuDividerDef
components.description: A visual separator between groups of context menu items.

components.name: ContextMenuEntry
components.description: A discriminated union of all possible entries in a context menu.

components.name: ContextMenuItemDef
components.description:
An actionable item entry within a context menu.
Set `destructive` to visually flag dangerous actions like deletion.

components.name: ContextMenuLabelDef
components.description: A non-interactive section heading rendered above a group of context menu items.

components.name: DataList
components.description:
A definition list of key-value pairs laid out horizontally or vertically.
Use for spec sheets, metadata panels, or any structured label-value display.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction for label/value pairs

props.name: striped
props.description: Alternate row backgrounds

components.name: DataListItem
components.description: A single key-value entry rendered inside a `DataList`.

components.name: DataTable
components.description: Registry documentation type — concrete version of DataTableProps for AI tooling.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description:
A date field: a read-only trigger 
{@link 
Input 
}
 that opens a 
{@link 
Popover 
}

containing an inline 
{@link 
Calendar 
}
. Controlled via an ISO `yyyy-mm-dd`
string — no `Date` objects cross the public boundary. Selecting a date (or
pressing Escape) closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger.
`Calendar` and `DateRange` share this same ISO-string vocabulary, per
ADR-024 (`docs/adr/ADR-024-date-value-vocabulary.md`).

props.name: value
props.description: Selected date as a `yyyy-mm-dd` ISO string, or `null` when empty.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected date (`yyyy-mm-dd`).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date (`yyyy-mm-dd`, inclusive).

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date (`yyyy-mm-dd`, inclusive).

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description:
Predicate deciding whether a date is disabled. When supplied it is
authoritative and wins over `min`/`max`.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for month/weekday labels and the formatted trigger value.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week, 0 (Sunday) … 6. Defaults to the locale, then Monday.

props.name: label
props.description: Label rendered above the trigger input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown on the trigger input when no date is selected.

props.name: placement
props.description: Popover placement relative to the trigger.

props.name: id
props.description: Trigger input id (associates the label).

components.name: DateRange
components.description:
Inline, locale-aware month grid for date-range selection. Controlled via a

{@link 
DateRangeValue 
}
 of ISO `yyyy-mm-dd` strings — no `Date` objects
cross the public boundary, per ADR-024
(`docs/adr/ADR-024-date-value-vocabulary.md`), which unifies the value
contract across `Calendar`/`DatePicker`/`DateRange`.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected range. `end` is `null` while the second endpoint is being picked.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next range. Endpoints are always ordered (`start` ≤ `end`).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date (`yyyy-mm-dd`, inclusive).

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date (`yyyy-mm-dd`, inclusive).

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description:
Predicate deciding whether a date is disabled. When supplied it is
authoritative and wins over `min`/`max`; range bounds apply only when no
predicate is given.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for month/weekday labels.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week, 0 (Sunday) … 6. Defaults to the locale, then Monday.

components.name: DateRangeValue
components.description:
A selected date range as `yyyy-mm-dd` ISO strings. Either endpoint may be
`null` while a range is being picked. Matches the ISO-string vocabulary
`Calendar`/`DatePicker` use, per ADR-024
(`docs/adr/ADR-024-date-value-vocabulary.md`).

components.name: DepartureBoard
components.description:
A split-flap departure board that flips through a sequence of headlines or
value-props — the signature marketing hero. It composes 
{@link 
SplitFlap 
}

(no fork) for the mechanical flap animation, cycling the board through each
phrase on a timer.

Respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`, it renders the current phrase as plain
static text and stops auto-advancing. In every mode the current phrase is
exposed to assistive technology while the decorative flap glyphs are hidden.

props.name: phrases
props.description: Ordered phrases the board cycles through. Characters outside the charset render as spaces.

props.name: holdMs
props.description: Ms each phrase is held before the board flips to the next.

props.name: flipInterval
props.description: Ms between each intermediate flip within a single cell (passed to SplitFlap).

props.name: cascadeDelay
props.description: Ms delay before each subsequent cell begins its flip cascade (passed to SplitFlap).

props.name: charset
props.description: Character set the flap cells can cycle through.

props.name: size
props.description: Cell size preset.

props.name: length
props.description: Fixed cell count — pads/truncates every phrase to this width. Defaults to the longest phrase.

components.name: Dialog
components.description:
A modal dialog that renders centered over a backdrop overlay.
Traps focus inside the panel while open and closes on Escape or backdrop click.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content rendered below the body in a fixed footer area

components.name: Divider
components.description:
Visual separator for dividing content sections, rendered as a thin rule.

Supports an optional centered text label and a gold accent gradient for
emphasis. Renders `role="separator"` with the appropriate `aria-orientation`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation

props.name: label
props.description: Optional centered label

props.name: accent
props.description: Gold accent gradient instead of neutral

props.name: spacing
props.description: Spacing: compact (xs), default (md), spacious (lg)

components.name: Drawer
components.description:
A slide-out panel that enters from an edge of the viewport over a backdrop.
Use for secondary content, forms, or detail views that should not fully replace the page.
Locks body scroll while open and closes on Escape or backdrop click.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content rendered below the body in a fixed footer area

props.name: side
props.description: Which edge the drawer slides from

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width/height

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description:
A click-triggered dropdown menu for presenting a list of actions.
Supports keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End, Enter, Escape),
item icons, shortcut hints, dividers, section labels, and destructive items.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger element — rendered as-is, click opens the menu

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries: items, dividers, labels

props.name: align
props.description: Align dropdown to left (default) or right edge of trigger

components.name: EmptyState
components.description:
Props for the EmptyState component, a centered placeholder shown when a list, table,
or content area has no items to display.

If no `icon` is provided a default open-box illustration is rendered automatically.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon — rendered above the heading

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading text

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Semantic heading level for the heading, routed through the Heading primitive.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text below the heading

props.name: action
props.description: Action slot — typically a Button

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface variant

props.name: size
props.description: Size — affects icon size, spacing, and typography

components.name: ErrorBoundary
components.description:
Catches unhandled React render errors and displays a user-friendly fallback
instead of crashing the entire app to a blank screen.

Must be a class component — React does not support error boundaries as
function components (as of React 19).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Optional custom fallback UI. When omitted, a default "Something went wrong" message is shown.

props.name: onError
props.description: Optional callback invoked when an error is caught. Use to report errors to external services.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Semantic heading level for the default fallback title.

components.name: Ferrofluid
components.description:
A decorative ferrofluid-style fluid animation. Several SVG circles drift
through a container; an SVG `feGaussianBlur` + `feColorMatrix` filter fuses
any overlapping circles into continuous blobs, producing the liquid
surface-tension effect of magnetic fluid.

Purely decorative — always `aria-hidden`. If you need it to convey meaning,
wrap it and add your own semantics in the parent.

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color for the blobs.

props.name: blobCount
props.description: How many blobs to render.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed preset.

props.name: blurAmount
props.description: Blur intensity. Higher = more liquid/merged.

props.name: matrix
props.description: 2D boolean grid — `true` = on (bright), `false` = off (dark). Outer array = rows.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for screen readers — required because the component renders as role="img".

props.name: cols
props.description: Override column count. Matrix is padded/truncated to fit.

props.name: rows
props.description: Override row count. Matrix is padded/truncated to fit.

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Dot diameter in px.

props.name: dotGap
props.description: Gap between dots in px.

props.name: enableSound
props.description: Enable mechanical click sound.

props.name: soundVolume
props.description: Sound volume 0–1.

props.name: staggerDelay
props.description: Base stagger delay between dots in ms.

props.name: staggerJitter
props.description: Random jitter factor (0–1) added to stagger timing.

props.name: staggerDirection
props.description: Direction of the flip cascade.

components.name: Footer
components.description:
Page footer with two layout variants.

- **minimal** (default) — horizontal flex row for utility bars, kbd hints, inline links.
- **rich** — centered column with logo, multi-column link groups, and copyright.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo element for the rich variant. Defaults to "Rialto" text.

props.name: columns
props.description: Multi-column link groups (rich variant).

props.name: copyright
props.description: Bottom-line copyright text (rich variant).

components.name: Form
components.description:
Owns submit-time validation across its `FormField` descendants: collects
each field's error, blocks submission while any field is invalid, and
announces failures through an assertive error summary.

props.name: onValidSubmit
props.description: Called with the submit event once every registered field passes validation.

props.name: showErrorSummary
props.description: Renders an accessible summary of current field errors above the fields. Default true.

components.name: FormContextValue
components.description:
Validation context shared between `Form` and its `FormField` descendants.
`Form` owns the state; `FormField` registers a validator and reads back
the current submit/error state to wire into its wrapped control.

components.name: FormField
components.description:
Connects a single field element to the enclosing `Form`'s validation
context: registers `validate` under `name`, then forwards the resulting
`id`, `error`, and `hint` (the validation message) onto the field so its
own label/hint/error wiring (via its internal `useField`) picks them up.

props.name: name
props.description: Unique field name; keys this field's error in the enclosing Form's validation state.

props.name: validate
props.description: Runs at submit time; return an error message, or undefined when the field is valid.

props.name: children
props.description: A single field element — Input, TextArea, NumberInput, Select, or Combobox.

components.name: GlobalNav
components.description:
Cross-app navigation bar for mattbutlerengineering.com.

Uses full `<a href>` tags (not React Router `<Link>`) because
navigation between apps requires full page loads — each app is
served by a separate Cloudflare Worker.

props.name: currentApp
props.description: Which app is currently active — drives the active link indicator.

props.name: theme
props.description: Current resolved theme for the theme toggle icon.

props.name: onThemeToggle
props.description: Called when the user clicks the theme toggle.

components.name: Heading
components.description:
Semantic heading primitive. `level` controls the rendered HTML element
(`h1`–`h6`) and is the primary input — it represents document outline
position. `size` decouples visual weight from semantic level when those
need to diverge (e.g., a big section opener that's still the page's
second heading).

Uses the display font (Bricolage Grotesque) with tight leading and
tight tracking, matching Rialto's `Text variant="display"` DNA.

props.name: level
props.description: Semantic heading level — also the default rendered element.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size override. Defaults to `level`.

props.name: color
props.description: Override the default color for the level

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment

props.name: as
props.description: Render as a different HTML element (e.g., "div" for visual-only headings)

props.name: truncate
props.description: Truncate with ellipsis (single line)

components.name: Hero
components.description:
Marketing splash section with centered content, atmospheric
decorative touches, and a fade-up entrance animation.

Wrap text in `<span className="accent">` inside `title`
to apply the gold accent color.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small uppercase label above the title.

props.name: title
props.description: Main heading — supports ReactNode for accent span wrapping.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Description paragraph below the title.

props.name: actions
props.description: CTA buttons or links slot.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum section height. Default "85vh".

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Show a gold accent divider between subtitle and actions. Default true.

components.name: HoverCard
components.description:
A rich hover preview card that appears when the user hovers or focuses the trigger.
Unlike Tooltip, HoverCard is intended for richer content (images, metadata, links)
and remains open while the pointer is inside the card itself.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element — hovered to open the card

props.name: content
props.description: Rich content rendered inside the glass panel

props.name: placement
props.description: Placement relative to trigger

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Delay in ms before showing (default 400ms)

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay in ms before hiding after mouse leaves (default 200ms)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class on the panel

components.name: IconButton
components.description:
Icon-only action trigger.

Composes 
{@link 
Button 
}
 for all button semantics, focus-ring, and tactile
press-depth — this primitive only constrains the footprint to a square and
enforces an accessible label. Because there is no visible text, `aria-label`
is **required at the type level**: omitting it is a compile error.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph to render — a ~16–20px icon or inline SVG.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Accessible label announced by screen readers. REQUIRED — an icon-only
control has no text content, so omitting this is a compile error.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `"primary"` (gold fill), `"secondary"` (aluminum outline), `"ghost"` (no border).

components.name: ImageUpload
components.description:
A placeholder tile that accepts an image via click or drag-and-drop.
The tile visually *becomes* the image — the empty state matches the shape
of the final preview, making the upload feel like completion rather than form-filling.

Fully controlled: the parent owns `value`, `progress`, `done`, and `error` state.

components.name: Odometer
components.description:
A mechanical rolling-counter. Reads a numeric `value`, formats it with locale
grouping via `Intl.NumberFormat`, and animates digit changes by composing the

{@link 
SplitFlap 
}
 primitive — each contiguous run of digits becomes a reel
that rolls to its target, extending SplitFlap's Solari physics to numbers.

Grouping separators (`,` `.` currency symbols, sign) render as static glyphs
between the reels. On each value change the reel block re-settles with the
token spring; `prefers-reduced-motion` snaps to the final value with no roll
(SplitFlap honors it internally, and the container skips its settle).

Accessibility: the animated reels are decorative and hidden from assistive
tech. A single polite, atomic live region announces the whole formatted
number — never per-digit. Any `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` you pass names
that live region (not just the role-less wrapper), so screen readers announce
the label with the value. Pairs naturally with `Stat` and hero metrics.

props.name: flipInterval
props.description: Ms between each intermediate flip within a reel.

props.name: cascadeDelay
props.description: Ms delay before each subsequent digit in a reel starts.

and slides offscreen in opposite directions, revealing what's beneath.
Inspired by classic RPG/strategy game login screens.

The parent owns navigation — fire it from `onExitComplete`, not immediately
after setting `active`, or the content unmounts before the animation runs.

half). Purely presentational children are fine; stateful ones (forms with
uncommitted input, components with unique `id`s, anything using refs
attached from outside) will have two concurrent instances during the ~600ms
animation. Keep children simple or snapshot them to static markup before
flipping `active` to true.

components.description:
Loader styled after the exhibition caseback of a mechanical automatic watch:
a sweeping rotor, a meshing gear train, an oscillating balance wheel, a ticking
escape wheel, and ruby jewels at the pivots. The metaphor is *precision in
motion* — an indeterminate "working" indicator with no progress semantics.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name — required because the component renders as role="img".

props.name: size
props.description: Preset (48 / 80 / 120px) or a raw pixel number.

props.name: speed
props.description: Scales every animation duration proportionally.

props.name: variant
props.description: Metallic finish — flips CSS custom properties only.
